items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And we were all living in the same flat

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Oh yeah, sure! But Adelaide had this big house, and most of it was closed off, because there was no central heating. But she had a girl working for her, and she used to light the fire every evening. She'd set the burner that when I come in, so that I'd be warm at night. But in the daytime, man, I used to go outside to get warm. But you get used to it, you get around and you go to the different places. Of course, you know the first time I was there, I got over there just while they were still rationing, and there…
